# Repository Conventions

- This is a dependency-free static personal microsite for Chad Hage.
- Public content belongs in `site/`; GitHub Actions publishes only that folder.
- Keep the homepage usable when opened directly as a local file.
- Use relative paths for local pages and assets.
- Preserve responsive layouts, semantic HTML, keyboard focus, reduced-motion
  support, and light/dark color themes.
- Use the existing `--cp-*` CSS color variables and typography.
- Do not add a framework or build dependencies without a concrete need.
- The production URL is <https://chadhage.github.io/> and requires the GitHub
  repository `chadhage/chadhage.github.io`.
- Never commit, push, or change remote settings without explicit authorization.
- After changes, verify desktop and mobile layouts and update README.md when
  preview or publishing instructions change.
